summary: Provision ephemeral research seats and SCIM/SSO onboarding for DeepTrace analytics
description:
Issue summary: The Research Platform team needs short-term (ephemeral) and a small set of permanent admin seats for a vendor analytics tool, DeepTrace. This ticket coordinates procurement, identity (SCIM/SSO), security gating, and finance tagging so the vendor can be onboarded and researchers can start experiments without manual seat invites.

Impact: 25 researchers are blocked from running time-sensitive benchmark experiments planned for week of 2026-03-22. Delays reduce our velocity on the inference cost/quality comparison project and push back downstream model selection by ~2 sprints. The vendor evaluation was approved by Product and Research; we need seats and access configured to begin.

Request: Procure 30 seats total (25 ephemeral researcher seats with auto-expiry at 6 months, 5 permanent seats for admins/engineers). Enable SCIM for group provisioning, SAML SSO with Redwood IdP, and mapping of seats to cost center R&D-ENG-2026. Provide a PO and invoice cadence that supports monthly billing for ephemeral seats with a cap.

Background: DeepTrace is a privacy-aware analytics vendor that runs model telemetry and inference tracing within a hosted console. Legal completed a vendor risk snapshot on 2026-03-05 with conditional acceptance (no PII export). Security requested a tighter SCIM group-to-role mapping and encrypted provisioning (TLS + certificate pinning). Research requested ephemeral seats so contractors and short-term hiring can be added/removed without a manual contract amendment.

Acceptance criteria: 1) PO issued and finance confirms billing mapping to cost center R&D-ENG-2026; 2) DeepTrace SCIM connection tested in staging and provisioning creates groups and adds 25 researcher members automatically; 3) SAML SSO metadata exchanged and SSO login works for at least one admin and one researcher account; 4) Security confirms data-handling controls from vendor are acceptable and documents required controls in runbook; 5) Procurement confirms license entitlement expiration and auto-revocation policy is in place for ephemeral seats.
timeline: Requested start: 2026-03-15. Needed by: 2026-03-22 for experiment kickoff. Procurement to complete PO within 5 business days. Identity team to complete SCIM/SSO tests within 3 business days after PO. Security sign-off parallel to identity testing.
seat_breakdown: 25 ephemeral researcher seats (auto-expire in 180 days), 5 permanent admin seats. Ephemeral seats should be billed monthly with pro-rated charges and an upper monthly cap of $6,000. Admin seats billed annually under enterprise seat bundle.
security_requirements: Legal and Security conditional approval dated 2026-03-05. Requirements include: vendor SOC2 Type II report (reviewed), encrypted in-transit and at-rest defaults, SCIM over HTTPS, no export of user-level PII, audit log access for admin seats, and a signed DPA. Security asks that we document retention limits and prove deletion on seat expiry.
scim_requirements: SCIM provisioning to create groups: 'deeptrace-researchers' and 'deeptrace-admins'. Attributes required: userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work].value, externalId (employee ID), and groups mapping. Provisioning must support group membership updates and de-provision on membership removal. SCIM tests should be done in a DeepTrace staging tenant before production.
sso_requirements: SAML 2.0 integration using Redwood IdP. Required fields: IdP metadata XML, ACS URL from DeepTrace staging, SP entity ID, signed assertions, and attribute mapping for email, groups, and role. One admin user and one researcher user must be validated in staging before go-live.
